name: degraded-nightscout-pilot
faults_start: when the app first displays the session's t0 reading (warm-up is healthy); recorded as faultsStartAt

per_request._rule: Draw u = mulberry32(fnv1a32(`${sessionSeed}:${endpointClass}:${perClassRequestIndex}`)). Walk faults in this order, first whose cumulative p covers u wins; else pass-through. Only classes listed in applies_to are eligible.

stale_entries.serve: the oldest of the last 3 successful upstream bodies for this session+class

duplicate_entries.mutation: duplicate every record; v1 copies keep _id with suffix '-dup', v3 copies get new identifier; same date/sgv

episodes._rule: Per session, each episode type independently occurs with p_session (draw from mulberry32(fnv1a32(`${sessionSeed}:episode:${type}`))); start offset uniform in start_window_s after faultsStartAt, duration uniform in duration_s. Episodes override per_request faults for affected classes.

replica_down.effect: requests round-robined to replica B go to a closed port (real ECONNREFUSED) and the gateway answers 502 like an LB without health checks; replica A requests still succeed
